purpose: distinguish H1 (start[0] transient amplified by the frozen unbalanced energy window) from H2 (basin-specific collapsed-U / scalar interaction)

kernel_hashes.change_disclosure: the only change is an optional movement_tracker parameter added to run_collapsed_u_chain after rep2 launched (None in this probe and in both formal runs' call pattern); collapsed_u_mh_step, collapsed_ffbs_sweep_once and the likelihood are untouched; every=0 bitwise parity and resume determinism tests pass against the current source

config.update_order: collapsed U MH -> exact FFBS refresh of all (S,z) -> (pi/P fixed) -> conditional U rows -> rho -> beta -> omega -> lambda_rep -> lambda_back

extraction_rules_registered.per_chain_energy: 2000 equally spaced draws per 16,000-draw window: stride 8, offset 0
extraction_rules_registered.chain_balanced_energy: 1000 equally spaced draws per chain per window (stride 16, offset 0), concatenated to 4,000 with equal chain contribution
extraction_rules_registered.coordinates: the EXACT frozen-gate coordinates [closure indicators, per-trace segment counts, scalars]; the gate_failure_diagnosis per-chain numbers used a total-count approximation and are reported alongside for comparability, not for the verdict
extraction_rules_registered.envelope: calibrate_energy_envelope, seed 5, 40 replicates — the frozen diagnostic's own
extraction_rules_registered.scalar_offsets: offset_sd = (window mean - reference mean) / reference SD; offset_se = offset_sd * sqrt(window bulk ESS); verdict thresholds of 2 apply to offset_se; early-to-late contraction judged on median |offset_sd| across chains

A_transient: late chain-balanced statistic inside its envelope
at most 1 of 4 late per-chain z > +2
no control scalar with >=3/4 same-direction late |offset_se| > 2
late ESS finite and structure still moving
B_basin_interaction_any_of: >=3/4 late per-chain z > +2 AND their median > +2
late chain-balanced statistic outside its envelope
>=3/4 chains same-direction late beta offset_se magnitude > 2
>=3/4 chains same-direction late lambda_rep offset_se magnitude > 2
median |offset_sd| does not shrink early->middle->late (late >= early) for beta or lambda_rep
joint same-direction beta+lambda_rep displacement (both offset_se magnitude > 2) in >=3/4 chains with clean controls
verdict_rules_preregistered.C: neither A nor B -> START-0 FOCUSED PROBE INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules_preregistered.note: the historical frozen gate is reported unchanged and is NOT the decision statistic; run 1 and rep2 remain recorded failures regardless of this probe
